senses.gloss: (deriv. of next w.) to reduce to widowhood, bereave, desert.
units: Pes. 49ᵃ ומְאַלְמֵן את אשתו will be forced to desert his wife (to leave his home).—Nithpa. נִתְאַלְמְנָה to become a widow.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:1:1">Y. Keth. II, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> (Mishn. ed., a. Talm. Bab. <he>נִתְאַרְמְלָה</he>, v. <cite ref="A03179"><he>אִרְמֵל</he></cite>).
